sources: Levacy, Beneath a Vedic Sky — ch. 16, Remedial Measures.
Charak, Elements of Vedic Astrology — propitiation in the health chapter.
Sutton, The Essentials of Vedic Astrology.
selection_rules: Wear the stone of the lagna lord, of the running dasha lord, or of a graha you deliberately want to strengthen.
Never strengthen a functional malefic for your lagna. Check the functional table before recommending anything.
A gemstone is worn to strengthen a graha, not to appease one. To reduce a graha's pressure, use charity, fasting and mantra instead.
The stone must be natural, untreated, at least the listed minimum weight, and must touch the skin.
First worn on that graha's weekday, in that graha's hour, after the prescribed japa.
If a stone cannot be afforded, an upa-ratna of the same colour is acceptable. Never impoverish yourself for a remedy.
Test any stone — blue sapphire especially — for three days before committing.
honesty_clause: PocketAstro states plainly what a remedy is: a structured intention. Mantra, charity and discipline change behaviour and attention, and behaviour is most of what a dasha actually operates on. No stone replaces sleep, a medical appointment, a lawyer, or leaving a job that is burning you. Every graha entry here carries a practical counterpart, and the practical counterpart is the one PocketAstro leads with.
never: Never sell or recommend a remedy as a cure for illness, infertility, or legal jeopardy.
Never price a remedy, or imply that a costlier stone works better.
Never recommend a remedy for a dosha that has been cancelled.
Never use fear to motivate a remedy.

general_upaya.yagya: A Vedic fire ceremony performed by qualified priests; requires the birth nakshatra and a stated intention.
general_upaya.mantra: Sound repeated correctly and consistently. Count matters less than regularity.
general_upaya.shanti: Contact with a substance associated with the graha — wearing, eating or offering it.
general_upaya.dana: Charity. Levacy's rule: when a chart shows a period of loss, lose on purpose, usefully.
general_upaya.seva: Service to the people that graha signifies — the elderly for Saturn, teachers for Jupiter, mothers for the Moon.
general_upaya.vastu: Orientation and arrangement of living space by direction.

by_house_affliction.1: Physical discipline and sleep before anything ritual.
by_house_affliction.2: Speech discipline and a written budget.
by_house_affliction.4: Settle the home. Repair the mother relationship or grieve it properly.
by_house_affliction.6: Clear the debt, treat the illness, and reduce the workload. In that order.
by_house_affliction.7: Say the unsaid thing to the partner. Most 7th-house remedies are conversations.
by_house_affliction.8: Get the tax, insurance and medical paperwork current.
by_house_affliction.10: Make the work visible. An afflicted 10th is usually good work nobody sees.
by_house_affliction.12: Sleep, boundaries, and a real retreat practice.

Sun.time: sunrise, during the first hour after dawn
Sun.beej_mantra: Om Hraam Hreem Hraum Sah Suryaya Namah
charity: a meal to a father figure
Sun.practical: Surya Namaskar at dawn; deal with the father relationship directly; take the title or role rather than doing the work anonymously. A ruby will not substitute for asking to be recognised.

Moon.beej_mantra: Om Shraam Shreem Shraum Sah Chandraya Namah
Moon.practical: Sleep on a schedule; water; a settled home base; repair or grieve the mother relationship honestly. Most Moon afflictions in a modern life are sleep debt and an unsettled home, and respond to that before they respond to a pearl.

Mars.beej_mantra: Om Kraam Kreem Kraum Sah Bhaumaya Namah
charity: support for someone in the armed services or trades
Mars.practical: Hard physical training on a schedule. An honest outlet for anger, and a rule about not sending the message within 24 hours of a fight. Coral without an outlet just raises the temperature.

Mercury.beej_mantra: Om Braam Breem Braum Sah Budhaya Namah
Mercury.practical: Study something structured. Write things down. Read every contract twice. Nerve-calming basics — less caffeine, more walking — do more for an afflicted Mercury than any stone.

Jupiter.beej_mantra: Om Graam Greem Graum Sah Gurave Namah
charity: support for a teacher or a temple
Jupiter.practical: Find an actual teacher and submit to actual correction. Teach something yourself. Jupiter remedies fail when the person collects wisdom and applies none of it.

Venus.beej_mantra: Om Draam Dreem Draum Sah Shukraya Namah
Venus.practical: Make something beautiful with your hands. Keep one room genuinely pleasant. Be honest about what you actually want from a partner — an afflicted Venus is usually an unspoken standard, not a missing gem.

Saturn.beej_mantra: Om Praam Preem Praum Sah Shanaischaraya Namah
charity: a hot meal for a labourer or someone unhoused
Saturn.caution: Blue sapphire is the one stone every classical source warns about. Trial it for three days before committing, and only wear it if Saturn is a functional benefic for the lagna.
Saturn.practical: Show up on time for a year. Fixed sleep, honest accounts, unglamorous work done well. Saturn's remedy is almost entirely behavioural, and it works.

Rahu.beej_mantra: Om Bhraam Bhreem Bhraum Sah Rahave Namah
Rahu.practical: Reduce the input. Cut the feed, the leverage and the substance. Rahu's real remedy is a deliberate limit on appetite — a stone does nothing against an unlimited scroll.

Ketu.beej_mantra: Om Sraam Sreem Sraum Sah Ketave Namah
charity: support for a spiritual or research institution
Ketu.practical: Sit still daily. Finish what is already finished — the unclosed account, the relationship that ended years ago. Ketu is the one graha whose remedy is genuinely meditation.
